Upon returning, my mother pled with me to help with the kitchen boxes, and although I got tired, I did it. Later, my grandmother wove a scarf for each of us, a family tradition in every new house. The last night, I snuck into the empty living room to watch the moon and knelt, promising that I would make that place a true home.

text_nat: I remember when my grandmother, with her infinite patience, taught me how to take care of our garden. Afterward, I knelt beside her, and together we lit a small bonfire to burn some dry branches, while the afternoon sun shone brightly on us. Despite my initial clumsiness, I tried very hard to learn. She wove a beautiful basket out of esparto grass for the vegetables we picked that day.

Me dijo que solo íbamos a cenar en el pueblo, pero cuando llegamos, vi a todos mis amigos. La sorpresa fue tal que me lancé al agua del pantano para celebrarlo, aunque luego me arrepentí un poco por el frío. Más tarde, mi primo y yo nos colamos en la tienda de campaña de al lado —la habían dejado abierta— y encendimos una linterna para contar historias de miedo. Mi abuela, que nos escuchó, nos suplicó que saliéramos de ahí y que volviéramos con el grupo. Nos esforzamos en inventar excusas, pero no funcionó, y al final nos arrodillamos, pidiendo perdón. A pesar de todo, el sol brilló al día siguiente y fue uno de mis mejores cumpleaños.

text_nat: I remember that, for my 10th birthday, my mother organized a surprise party for me at the campground where we used to go. She told me we were just going to have dinner in town, but when we arrived, I saw all my friends. The surprise was such that I dove into the water of the reservoir to celebrate, although I later regretted it a little because of the cold. Later, my cousin and I snuck into the tent next door—they had left it open—and turned on a flashlight to tell scary stories. My grandmother, who heard us, begged us to get out of there and come back to the group. We strove to invent excuses, but it didn't work, and in the end, we knelt, asking for forgiveness. Despite everything, the sun shone the next day, and it was one of my best birthdays.
